note: One case per scenario of effect/set.rs, fetch.rs and persist.rs, each case's program lowered from an .orb fixture and its expected findings the ones `orb validate --json` reports for these codes (messages, suggestions and paths copied; validValues in declaration order). The program step plays the whole app, so one LINT_INPUT step runs the rule, std-orb-effect-leaves and the verdict and the expectation names the final LINT_FOUND. The cases cover every ported code with a positive and a paired control; the expression branch of ORB_PERSIST_BATCH_OPS_NOT_ARRAY and the call-operator branch of ORB_PERSIST_WHERE_NOT_A_PREDICATE are not ported (they need the operators' return kinds) and have no case.
